_about: Sources read 2 October 2026 for the first World War II batch of the war memorial sourcing (Nathan: 'run the rest in batches of about ten on the same pattern ... start there' with the 88 Honor List pages). Honor List lines read by eye from the page images in inventory/legacy/fetched/nara-honor-list-ca/ (the OCR text is not relied on); enlistment records from NARA AAD (RG 64) in a browser; ABMC from its Burial and Memorialization Directory in a browser; the archive's own documents from web/uploads/archive-media/legacy/.
